claims.statement: In the FPT/GHEC branch, organization use of SSH certificate authorities requires Enterprise Cloud, with the previously inspected trial include as a pointer. This is branch-specific rather than universal denial of GHES SSH CA support; no entitlement, trial signup, credential registration or trust configuration was verified.

The containing team API endpoints require authenticated membership of the team's organization, and OAuth access tokens require read:org scope. GitHub generates team slug from its name; accepted pull/push permissions map to organization-repository Read/Write roles. This endpoint-context rule is distinct from the enterprise-team API's different token capabilities/scopes. It does not authorize every endpoint, prove slug normalization, define all token types, or establish a successful API observation; linked scope/role references remain separate review work.

Both FPT/GHEC and GHES branches label Team Discussions retired and point to a historical announcement; GitHub Discussions is identified as an alternative for organization-level discussions. Pinned release/product variables resolve retired and GitHub Discussions. This is not an executed migration, live feature verification, preservation receipt or automatic permission equivalence; outbound pages are not reviewed by reference.

The Team notifications Enabled/Disabled choice affects mentions of the team name only, not review-request notifications directed to the team. Disabling mentions must not be generalized to silencing all team notifications or enforcing reviewer coverage; no setting or delivery behavior was tested.

In the FPT/GHEC branch, Enterprise Cloud team synchronization can add and remove existing organization members from teams through an IdP. The FPT text points to Cloud documentation; it does not grant the feature to every Free organization. This is not provisioning organization membership, a universal EMU/SCIM mechanism, support on GHES, or verified live sync; the linked guide remains separate review work.

A team description is optional in the containing creation/editing procedure. Absence of a description is not automatically a failing platform requirement; this does not prove created team identity, mandatory local policy or executed change.
